description:

title: Private Eyes
description:

A computer programmer hires Shade and Angie to recover a hard drive, which is locked in a secure lab.

title: Private Eyes
description:

title: Family Law
description:

Abby scrambles to undo the damage after she advises a pair of exhausted parents to surrender their autistic son to the Ministry for support and her clients are charged with neglect.

title: Family Law
description:

When a heart attack lands Judge Chip Crombie in the hospital and both of his wives show up, Abby revels in her nemesis' shame at being exposed as a bigamist.

title: Family Law
description:

When the lucrative Bass divorce is derailed by allegations of husband Connery's embezzling, Abby and Daniel race to get their client clear.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E08 — Where There's a Will
The parallels to their own lives are unmistakable when both Abby and Daniel represent clients who want something a court can't order: their parents' respect.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E09 — Catch 22
Abby's client, Naomi, wants a medically assisted death before Alzheimer's destroys her capacity to consent, but with time running out, Naomi's grieving son seeks a court order to block her access.

title: Family Law
description:
S03 E10 — The Chickens Come Home to Roost
When a DNA test reveals that Carla's daughter was switched at birth, Abby fights for her client's right to know her biological child; Sofia's school essay on secrets makes Abby question whether all the work she's done to stay sober was worth it.

title: Anna
description: Beneath a woman's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the most feared assassins on the planet.

title: Death Proof
description: Mike is a professional body double who uses his car to stalk and kill unsuspecting young women in the South.

description:

description:

Nancy is ready to give birth and marry Esteban until she discovers a secret; Silas and Doug's dispensary is in full swing; Celia hates her job; Andy goes on a spending spree.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy learns the identity of Esteban's other woman; a deputy gives Silas and Doug trouble; Celia learns that getting rich is not easy.

title: Weeds
description:

Tension mounts between Nancy and Esteban; Andy becomes more involved with Audra; Celia hatches a new scheme.

title: Two Small Voices
description: Two women (Mary McDonnell, Gail O'Grady) expose a cover-up by pharmaceutical companies about the dangers of silicone breast implants.

title: Trial by Media
description: Media investigations of family and friends shatter a senator's daughter (Christine Lahti) awaiting confirmation to become U.S. surgeon general.

title: Guilt by Association
description: A woman and her family suffer severe consequences when she is unjustly caught in the web of mandatory sentencing laws.

title: The Price of a Broken Heart
description: A woman (Park Overall) sues her husband's (Timothy Carhart) mistress (Laura Innes) on the basis of a North Carolina law designed to protect marriages from home-wreckers.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:

Frankie decides to celebrate every holiday and special occasion in rapid succession; Grace finds a shocking connection to a rising politician.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:

The women don disguises and head to a casino to spy on Coyote; Brianna also pretends to be someone she's not to appease a potential investor.

title: Grace and Frankie

title: Grace and Frankie
description:

Grace craves a comforting dish from her childhood, but only her estranged brother has the recipe; Sol and Peter team up to blackmail a theater critic.
